attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Pennsylvania state income tax calculation. Implements flat 3.07% tax on 8 classes of income. NO standard deduction, NO exemptions. ALL retirement income excluded. Per 72 P.S. § 7302-7303 (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Pennsylvania Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_compensation xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_interest xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_dividends xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_net_profits xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_gains xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_rents_royalties xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_estate_trust xdef 0.0 /result.pa_taxable_gambling xdef 0.0 /result.pa_total_income xdef 0.0 /result.pa_tax xdef 0.0 /result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0.0 /result.pa_social_security_exclusion xdef 0.0 /result.pa_pension_exclusion xdef 0.0 /result.pa_ira_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate all 8 PA income classes and apply 3.07% flat tax
action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay 0 gt { result.military_retirement_pay /result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion xdef "PA military retirement exclusion: $" result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if result.total_w2_wages result.pa_military_retirement_exclusion sub 0 max /result.pa_taxable_compensation xdef "PA Class 1 Compensation: $" result.pa_taxable_compensation cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
result.total_interest_income 0 max /result.pa_taxable_interest xdef
result.total_ordinary_dividends 0 max /result.pa_taxable_dividends xdef
result.total_schedule_c_income 0 max /result.pa_taxable_net_profits xdef
result.net_capital_gain 0 max /result.pa_taxable_gains xdef
result.total_rental_income 0 max /result.pa_taxable_rents_royalties xdef
0.0 /result.pa_taxable_estate_trust xdef
result.gambling_winnings 0 max /result.pa_taxable_gambling xdef
result.total_social_security 0 gt { result.total_social_security /result.pa_social_security_exclusion xdef "PA Social Security exclusion (100%): $" result.pa_social_security_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if
result.pa_taxable_compensation result.pa_taxable_interest add result.pa_taxable_dividends add result.pa_taxable_net_profits add result.pa_taxable_gains add result.pa_taxable_rents_royalties add result.pa_taxable_estate_trust add result.pa_taxable_gambling add /result.pa_total_income xdef
"PA Total Income (8 classes): $" result.pa_total_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
result.pa_total_income result.pa_tax_rate mul /result.pa_tax xdef result.pa_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"PA tax calculated (3.07% flat): $" result.pa_tax cvs strconcat " (on $" strconcat result.pa_total_income cvs strconcat " - NO deductions)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Pennsylvania Tax Calculation Completed" job.audit_trail swap addto
